name: @morphdoc/desktop
description: 墨呈桌面端：面向结构化 Markdown 的主题化文档创作与发布工具
author: YIXIONG Tech.ltd

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron dist/main.js --web-url=http://localhost:5173
scripts.package: pnpm run build:embedded-web && pnpm run prepare:pandoc && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs --x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:embedded-web && pnpm run prepare:pandoc:mac-arm64 && pnpm run build && MORPHDOC_MAC_TARGET_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm run build:embedded-web && pnpm run prepare:pandoc:mac-x64 && pnpm run build && MORPHDOC_MAC_TARGET_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64
scripts.make: pnpm run build:embedded-web && pnpm run prepare:pandoc && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --config electron-builder.config.cjs --x64
scripts.make:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:embedded-web && pnpm run prepare:pandoc:mac-arm64 && pnpm run build && MORPHDOC_MAC_TARGET_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.cjs --arm64
scripts.make:mac:x64: pnpm run build:embedded-web && pnpm run prepare:pandoc:mac-x64 && pnpm run build && MORPHDOC_MAC_TARGET_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.cjs --x64
scripts.make:mac: pnpm run make:mac:arm64 && pnpm run make:mac:x64
